Garage description
This paint was originally meant to look very different. However, an incident in garage #264, involving lots of paint buckets and an exploding gas tank, resulted in this rather colorful but appealing texture. The lead paint designer was so impressed, he decided to add it to the official collection for Fall 2016.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint appeared on September 29, 2016.
The paint was first sold in the shop for USD currency then it was moved to be sold in the garage for tankoins on April 10th, 2020.
